runtime/decimal#

The native layer under i18n/gettext, math/decimal: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under i18n/gettext, math/decimal: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native decimal_valid#

native decimal_valid(origin is string) is bool

Backend-neutral exact decimal decomposition. Every runtime provider must implement this contract without a binary floating-point round trip.

native decimal_canonical#

native decimal_canonical(origin is string) is string

origin as canonical decimal text.

native decimal_coefficient#

native decimal_coefficient(origin is string) is string

The coefficient of origin.

native decimal_exponent#

native decimal_exponent(origin is string) is int

The exponent of origin.

native decimal_order#

native decimal_order(left is string, right is string) is int

-1, 0 or 1 as left is less, equal or greater.
